codes.evidence_quote: Es llevar a este arte a su lugar de origen, al sitio primigenio donde se reunieran las desgracias de unos cuantos andaluces, payos y gitanos
codes.target: Sevilla as the proper site for the XXIV Congreso de Arte Flamenco
codes.rationale: The passage legitimates the congress location by grounding flamenco in a valued origin site and collective historical roots.

codes.evidence_quote: profundamente arraigado en la verdadera médula espinal de donde arranca el flamenco puro y hasta sus variantes más o menos admisibles
codes.target: the congress and the flamenco it presented
codes.rationale: The article invokes pure flamenco and only 'more or less admissible' variants, drawing a legitimacy boundary around acceptable forms.

codes.evidence_quote: este ha sido un Congreso serio de contenidos, abundantes en ofertas sonoras y literarias, con ciertas carencias de intendencia y protocolo
codes.target: the XXIV Congreso de Arte Flamenco
codes.rationale: The article explicitly evaluates the congress, praising its serious content while noting organizational shortcomings.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The phrase 'deberían estar canonizados' praises the organizers, but it is hyperbolic event praise rather than stable canon formation around artists, works, or styles.

derived_analysis.target: the Sevilla congress as rooted in flamenco origins and serious flamenco content

annotation_notes: Article is truncated, but the visible text contains sufficient explicit origin, purity, and evaluative discourse.

codes.evidence_quote: supone institucionalizar un precedente en la cooperación por estudiar, difundir y conservar el arte flamenco
codes.target: university involvement in the flamenco congress
codes.rationale: The passage authorizes flamenco through institutional university cooperation devoted to study, diffusion, and conservation.

codes.evidence_quote: figuras como José Menese, Antonio Mairena, Fosforito, Manuel Cano, etc., impartieron sus magistrales clases en las aulas de diversas Universidades españolas
codes.rationale: The text frames flamenco knowledge as taught through university spaces and master classes, making institutional pedagogy central.

codes.evidence_quote: Inés Bacán evidenció cierta frescura cantaora en sus siguiriyas, aunque adoleció de los determinados matices dramáticos del estilo
codes.rationale: The passage makes a balanced critical judgment, praising freshness while identifying a lack of dramatic nuance.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The verbs estudiar, difundir, and conservar suggest safeguarding, but the visible passage mainly stresses university authorization, so HERIT_02 is the more precise code.

derived_analysis.target: the XXIV Congreso and university-based study, diffusion, and conservation of flamenco

annotation_notes: Visible excerpt is enough to code institutional pedagogy and heritage authorization despite truncation.

codes.evidence_quote: esta música no pertenece a una estética sino a varias
codes.rationale: The passage defines flamenco quality through an explicit aesthetic framework of plurality and contrast.

codes.evidence_quote: merece más respeto y consideración que aquéllos que le han tributado hasta ahora los círculos oficiales, quizá por tener los oídos anestesiados con música escrita... y por desprecio, burguesa y estúpidamente aristocrático, hacia todo lo «popular»
codes.rationale: The passage uses critical authority to rebuke official and aristocratic dismissal of flamenco as popular art.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The article surveys historical influences and origins, but the visible text does not clearly use roots or continuity to authorize present proper flamenco.

derived_analysis.target: flamenco as a plural and undervalued aesthetic system

annotation_notes: Historical origin material is descriptive in the visible excerpt; the strongest coding is aesthetic and critical.

codes.evidence_quote: Culta porque, en su expresión más auténtica, niega la sensiblería... hace imposible el olvido de nuestras raíces
codes.rationale: The article attributes genuine cultural value to cante jondo by defining its authentic expression against sentimentality and forgetfulness.

codes.evidence_quote: el cante jondo es hoy... una de las formas de expresión musical más ricas, sabias, intensas y profundas que poseemos
codes.rationale: The passage applies aesthetic criteria of richness, wisdom, intensity, and depth to define cante jondo's value.

codes.evidence_quote: no debe aceptar por más tiempo la mirada altanera o displicente de quienes llevan su estupidez clasista hasta el terreno del arte, de quienes juzgan con sordera de corazón
codes.target: classist critics or dismissive observers of cante jondo
codes.rationale: The article critiques external classist judgment and contests who has the authority to value cante jondo.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: Roots and memory are invoked, but they are embedded in the broader authenticity and aesthetic argument already captured by AUTH_01 and CRIT_02.

derived_analysis.target: cante jondo as authentic, cultured, and aesthetically profound

annotation_notes: Although the article is truncated, the visible text strongly defines and defends cante jondo's value.

codes.evidence_quote: Lo contrario es caer en el error de creer que lo chabacano o, lo mal dicho, es lo auténticamente flamenco.
codes.target: claims that vulgar or badly articulated singing is authentically flamenco
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly rejects a false authenticity claim and draws a boundary around improper flamenco presentation.

codes.evidence_quote: la vocalización es fundamental y básica... Otro aspecto fundamental, es el de la afinación... El cante ha de ir cosido a su compás
codes.target: cantaor technique and flamenco singing aesthetics
codes.rationale: The article defines aesthetic criteria for good singing through vocalization, tuning, compás, and stylistic differentiation.

codes.evidence_quote: hay quien nos intenta vender esto como algo muy flamenco cuando es, en realidad, rematar desafinado
codes.target: performers or promoters who present poor tuning as flamenco authenticity
codes.rationale: The passage polices a boundary around proper flamenco by criticizing attempts to legitimize technical defects as flamenco style.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The phrase 'lo que hemos recibido' gestures toward inherited repertoire, but the main function is aesthetic guidance rather than a developed tradition-continuity claim.

derived_analysis.target: badly articulated, untuned, or homogenized singing presented as flamenco

annotation_notes: The article is a prescriptive critical argument about cantaor aesthetics, not merely a technical checklist.
